summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data preparation, experimentation, training, fine-tuning, deployment, monitoring, and governance—at scale, which is far more than what a hosted model API offers. You need a platform like these when you're building or customizing your own models, managing reproducible experiments across teams, handling large-scale training infrastructure, or requiring enterprise governance and MLOps; if you only need inference from a pre-built foundation model, a model API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) is simpler and cheaper. The market clusters around the three hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) plus Databricks, with specialized AutoML and MLOps tools filling adjacent niches.

platforms.name: Amazon SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage usage; billed per instance-hour for notebooks, training jobs, and endpoints. No upfront fee, SageMaker Savings Plans available.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams building and deploying custom models with deep integration across the AWS ecosystem.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute, training node-hours, prediction nodes, and AutoML training hours. Generative AI priced per token/character.
platforms.best_for: Highly automated, state-of-the-art workflows and generative AI on GCP with strong AutoML.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go for underlying compute; no surcharge for the ML service itself. Reserved instances and spot VMs available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem needing governance, responsible AI, and Azure OpenAI integration.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based via Databricks Units (DBUs) plus underlying cloud compute. Tiered by workload type.
platforms.best_for: Collaborative data science and heavy data engineering/ETL on a unified multi-cloud lakehouse.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; paid per-seat/usage plans for teams and enterprise. Custom enterprise pricing.
platforms.best_for: Best-in-class experiment tracking and MLOps observability layered on top of any training stack.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/license, custom-quoted. Usage and deployment-based tiers.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated end-to-end ML with strong governance and minimal coding.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; Driverless AI and enterprise LLM Studio via commercial subscription, custom-quoted.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting automated ML and generative AI with strong open-source roots and explainability.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second usage of CPU/GPU/memory; free monthly credits for starters. No idle charges.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless, Python-native GPU infrastructure for training and deploying models without managing clusters.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription and pay-as-you-go for Inference Endpoints and Spaces compute. Enterprise Hub plans.
platforms.best_for: Open-source model development, fine-tuning, and sharing/deploying transformer and generative models.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; costs are only underlying infrastructure (or managed via Databricks).
platforms.best_for: Open-source, framework-agnostic experiment tracking and model lifecycle management.
